boulder 2; mines, chasm, drop-offs, fences; crates only in the room
boulder 3 falls at bridge 2; 4 Nitro on the left edge; lone W beside the crystal

room 3 (4 incl. C) then boulder 4; lone edge crate + three fence groups; main-only cumulative 27

puzzles.summary: 1UP between two TNT in a 3-high column
puzzles.solution: land beside the column, jump and spin the middle crate
puzzles.wrongOrder: landing on the top TNT or spinning a TNT
puzzles.loss: life lost if a blast takes the 1UP crate (count kept)

puzzles.summary: 6 ? floating over 4 striped footing crates across a gap
puzzles.solution: break ?1-?5, clear striped crates with 10 stomps each, use ?6 last as the launch
puzzles.wrongOrder: breaking ?6 early or leaving a striped crate before it breaks
puzzles.loss: crate count (and possibly the exit launch)

puzzles.summary: final chase crates placed on the hazard side
puzzles.solution: take every speed pad, avoid mines, sidestep and spin back at each group

puzzles.summary: checkpoint crate resting on a ? crate

observations: 14 of 27 main crates sit where the pursuer cannot be (hut, three roofed rooms, after the boulder falls)
each boulder segment ends in a shelter holding a checkpoint plus 2-3 crates
main crates per section 6/3/5/13: only the last chase places crates in the danger lane
under pursuit every crate is off the safe line (pit lip, in front of fences on the avoided side)
speed pads and mines turn distance into the currency that buys the final crates
the only main-course explosives are 4 Nitro used as a lane restrictor; the explosive puzzle lives in the bonus
the bonus holds 39 % of all crates and teaches the side-spin used at the fences
no Aku crate in the stage
lives reward the two hardest crate spots (TNT sandwich, first fence)
no backtracking: missed chase crates are permanent for the run
openQuestions: how the 4 Nitro are counted/broken for the box gem (no green !)
